limitations: Known fixed grouping and branching factor; non-ambiguous uniform grammar; non-degeneracy and quantitative label-signal separation.
Fresh independent input-label samples per stage; fixed RBF random features, normalized outputs, layerwise regularized least-squares training.
The deep-learning positive result does not establish a universal shallow-model lower bound or ordinary end-to-end SGD convergence.
